name: @ship/sui-canvas
description: Ship Spatial pack — <sui-canvas> is the bare pan/zoom/infinite-surface substrate (backbone #3) built on @ship/sui-runtime signals. Pure framework: imports @ship/sui-runtime + @ship/sui-dom ONLY (no React, no Excalidraw, no SDK). The shared createCanvas() engine is the coordinate substrate the sibling faces (sui-board, sui-draw) build on. Per-tag tree-shake — consumers only pay for the tag they mount.
